records.title: Make a point of — 〜ようにする
records.english: I make a point of eating vegetables every day.
records.notes: Dictionary form (or ない-form) + ようにしている = I try to make a habit of (not) doing.

exercises.jp: 毎日/野菜/を/食べる/ように/して/います
exercises.en: I make a point of eating vegetables every day.
also: 野菜を毎日食べるようにしています

exercises.jp: 夜/は/甘い/物/を/食べない/ように/して/います
exercises.en: I try not to eat sweet things at night.

exercises.jp: 毎朝/日本語/の/ニュース/を/聞く/ように/して/います
exercises.en: I make a point of listening to the news in Japanese every morning.
also: 日本語のニュースを毎朝聞くようにしています

exercises.jp: 約束/に/遅れない/ように/して/います
exercises.en: I make sure not to be late for appointments.

exercises.jp: できる/だけ/階段/を/使う/ように/して/います
exercises.en: I try to use the stairs as much as possible.

records.title: Decide to — 〜ことにする
records.english: I've decided to take English lessons from next month.
records.notes: 〜ことにする = my own decision. 〜ことにしている = a rule I keep.

exercises.jp: 来月/から/英語/を/習う/こと/に/しました
exercises.en: I've decided to take English lessons from next month.
also: 英語を来月から習うことにしました

exercises.jp: 今年/は/タバコ/を/やめる/こと/に/しました
exercises.en: I've decided to quit smoking this year.

exercises.jp: 週末/は/家/で/ゆっくり/する/こと/に/しました
exercises.en: I've decided to take it easy at home this weekend.

exercises.jp: 毎晩/日記/を/書く/こと/に/して/います
exercises.en: I make it a rule to write a diary every night.
also: 日記を毎晩書くことにしています

exercises.jp: 平日/は/お酒/を/飲まない/こと/に/して/います
exercises.en: I make it a rule not to drink on weekdays.
also: お酒を平日は飲まないことにしています

records.title: Should be — 〜はずだ
records.english: Mr. Tanaka should already be at the station.
records.notes: Plain form + はずです = it should be so (an expectation with a reason).

exercises.jp: 田中さん/は/もう/駅/に/着いて/いる/はず/です
exercises.en: Mr. Tanaka should already be at the station.

exercises.jp: 荷物/は/明日/届く/はず/です
exercises.en: The parcel should arrive tomorrow.

exercises.jp: 彼/は/パーティー/に/来る/はず/です
exercises.en: He should be coming to the party.

exercises.jp: この/店/は/日曜日/も/開いて/いる/はず/です
exercises.en: This shop should be open on Sundays too.

exercises.jp: 鍵/は/かばん/の/中/に/ある/はず/です
exercises.en: The key should be in my bag.

records.title: Thanks to / because of — おかげで・せいで
records.english: Thanks to my teacher, I passed the exam.
records.notes: おかげで = thanks to (a good result). せいで = because of (a bad result).

exercises.jp: 先生/の/おかげで/試験/に/合格/しました
exercises.en: Thanks to my teacher, I passed the exam.

exercises.jp: 雨/の/せいで/試合/が/中止/に/なりました
exercises.en: Because of the rain, the match was called off.

exercises.jp: 友達/が/手伝って/くれた/おかげで/早く/終わりました
exercises.en: Thanks to my friend helping, it finished early.

exercises.jp: 寝坊/した/せいで/会議/に/遅れました
exercises.en: Because I overslept, I was late for the meeting.

exercises.jp: 薬/の/おかげで/熱/が/下がりました
exercises.en: Thanks to the medicine, my fever went down.

records.title: Make / let someone — 〜させる
records.english: Mum made my younger brother eat vegetables.
records.notes: Causative: 書く → 書かせる, 食べる → 食べさせる, する → させる. 〜させてください = please let me.

exercises.jp: 母/は/弟/に/野菜/を/食べさせました
exercises.en: Mum made my younger brother eat his vegetables.

exercises.jp: 先生/は/学生/に/作文/を/書かせました
exercises.en: The teacher made the students write an essay.

exercises.jp: 部長/は/私/に/資料/を/コピーさせました
exercises.en: The manager had me copy the documents.

exercises.jp: 子ども/を/公園/で/遊ばせました
exercises.en: I let the children play in the park.

exercises.jp: 少し/考えさせて/ください
exercises.en: Please let me think about it a little.

records.title: The more… — 〜ば〜ほど
records.english: The more you practise, the better you get.
records.notes: ば-form + the same word again + ほど = the more…, the more…

exercises.jp: 練習/すれば/する/ほど/上手/に/なります
exercises.en: The more you practise, the better you get.

exercises.jp: 考えれば/考える/ほど/わからなく/なります
exercises.en: The more I think about it, the less I understand.

exercises.jp: 日本語/は/勉強/すれば/する/ほど/面白く/なります
exercises.en: The more you study Japanese, the more interesting it gets.

exercises.jp: 野菜/は/新しければ/新しい/ほど/おいしい/です
exercises.en: The fresher vegetables are, the better they taste.

exercises.jp: 部屋/は/広ければ/広い/ほど/いい/です
exercises.en: The bigger the room, the better.

records.title: While still — 〜うちに
records.english: Please eat it while it's still warm.
records.notes: 〜うちに = while the state lasts, before it changes: 温かいうちに, 忘れないうちに.

exercises.jp: 温かい/うちに/食べて/ください
exercises.en: Please eat it while it's still warm.

exercises.jp: 若い/うちに/いろいろな/国/へ/行きたい/です
exercises.en: I want to visit lots of countries while I'm young.

exercises.jp: 雨/が/降らない/うちに/帰りましょう
exercises.en: Let's go home before it starts raining.

exercises.jp: 明るい/うちに/仕事/を/終わらせたい/です
exercises.en: I want to finish work while it's still light.

exercises.jp: 忘れない/うちに/メモ/して/おきます
exercises.en: I'll make a note before I forget.

records.title: No choice but — 〜しかない
records.english: The trains have stopped, so I have no choice but to walk home.
records.notes: Dictionary form + しかない (polite しかありません) = there's nothing for it but to…

exercises.jp: 電車/が/止まって/いる/から/歩いて/帰る/しか/ない
exercises.en: The trains have stopped, so there's nothing for it but to walk home.

exercises.jp: もう/時間/が/ない/から/タクシー/で/行く/しか/ありません
exercises.en: There's no time left, so we have no choice but to take a taxi.

exercises.jp: 自分/で/決める/しか/ありません
exercises.en: You have no choice but to decide for yourself.

exercises.jp: 店/が/閉まって/いた/から/コンビニ/で/買う/しか/なかった
exercises.en: The shop was closed, so I had to buy it at a convenience store.

exercises.jp: 誰/も/いない/から/自分/で/やる/しか/ない
exercises.en: There's nobody here, so I'll just have to do it myself.
